met_analysis:
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Jaisalmer, Kota, Guna, Sagar, Daltonganj, Digha and thence southeastwards towards Northeast Bay of Bengal extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level titling southwards with height. The east-west shear zone roughly along 23°N Lat. between 3.1 & 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwards with height across north peninsular India persists.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over Jammu & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level with a trough aloft in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 7.6 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 72°E to the north of Lat. 30°N persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northwest Bay of Bengal & adjoining north Odisha coast between 5.8 and 7.6 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
